resolved_conflicts.explanation: The ffla point (46.32866, -114.66782), the point listed on firelookout.org (cite 4), and the idaho_fl point (46.32381, -114.64983) are about 1.5 km apart. The story gives only the firelookout.org point and does not give the idaho_fl point. The township description on the Clearwater list was not used to choose between them

notes_for_editor: Two different Elk Summits exist. This record is the Clearwater list site (cupola cabin, 1924, gone). The standing 1934 tower near Elk City is us-id-elk-summit-2 and must not be merged with it. Only the 1924 date comes from a compiled 2016 list; no primary record was found. Nothing describes the site today. The county field in the brief holds only 'Idaho' and should read 'Idaho County'.
